title: THE DIRECTOR WATCHES BOTH PLAYERS
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the raid flow batch must work for both players. The Raid Director reads how the raid is going to give the waves a rhythm, but it read the host player alone: a hurt player 2 never earned a breather, machines hunting player 2 did not count as a fight, and a quiet stretch for player 1 while player 2 was under attack still swelled the waves and could call an ambush. The health player 2 loses now adds to the stress the way player 1 does, a machine hunting either of them within 700 counts as a fight, and a hurt player 2 ends the quiet stretch.
now: The wave rhythm now reacts to player 2 getting hurt and chased, not just player 1.

D.st=(+D.st||0)+lost/Math.max(40,+p.maxhp||100)*2.2;

if(fight||(G.t||0)-(+p.hurtAt||-999)<4||D.mhurt) D.quiet=0; else D.quiet=(+D.quiet||0)+dt;   // v16.xx (coop11): a quiet stretch is quiet for both
